title: How the Python SDK authenticates to ZIA: OneAPI, government clouds and legacy

prose.text: OneAPI is the unified Zidentity OAuth client; the older ZIA-specific key framework is the fallback for tenants not yet on Zidentity. The product-level OneAPI notes are in [[doc:references/shared/oneapi.md]] and the legacy framework in [[doc:references/shared/legacy-api.md]].

checks.do: Whether the tenant is on Zidentity (OneAPI) or still on the legacy ZIA framework, and which SDK major version is in use.
Whether the tenant is a government (FedRAMP) cloud, and whether the client version routes `gov` and `govus` at all.

oneapi-env-vars.statement: The Python SDK reads OneAPI credentials from the environment variables ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID, ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET, ZSCALER_VANITY_DOMAIN, ZSCALER_CLOUD and ZSCALER_PARTNER_ID, and a private key from ZSCALER_PRIVATE_KEY.

quotes: You can provide credentials via the `ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID`, `ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET`, `ZSCALER_VANITY_DOMAIN`, `ZSCALER_CLOUD`, `ZSCALER_PARTNER_ID` environment variables
`ZSCALER_PRIVATE_KEY`
evidence.after: You can provide credentials via the `ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID`

vanity-domain-token-url.statement: The vanity domain is the organization's Zidentity domain, and the commercial OAuth token endpoint is built from it as https://<vanity_domain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token.

quotes: Refers to the domain name used by your organization `https://<vanity_domain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token`
representing your Zidentity OneAPI credentials `clientId`, `clientSecret`, `vanityDomain`
evidence.after: You can provide credentials via the `ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID`

quotes: if cloud == "production": return f"https://{vanity_domain}.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token"
rather than the commercial ``zslogin{cloud}.net`` family.

oauth-audience.statement: The Python OAuth client always sends `audience=https://api.zscaler.com` in the client-credentials and JWT-assertion token requests.

quotes: "audience": "https://api.zscaler.com",
"audience": "https://api.zscaler.com",

cloud-optional.statement: The cloud attribute (ZSCALER_CLOUD) is optional and only required when authenticating to an alternative Zidentity cloud environment; without it the SDK uses the default base URL.

quotes: is optional and only required when authenticating to an alternative Zidentity cloud environment.
By default this SDK will send the authentication request and subsequent API calls to the default base URL.

partner-id-header.statement: When a partner ID is supplied through configuration or ZSCALER_PARTNER_ID the SDK adds an x-partner-id header to every request, on both the OneAPI and the legacy clients; without one the header is not sent.

quotes: the SDK automatically adds `x-partner-id: <partnerId>` to all request headers
If `partnerId` is not provided, the header is not included
When `partnerId` is provided via config dictionary or `ZSCALER_PARTNER_ID` environment variable
This feature works seamlessly across all services (ZIA, ZPA, ZTW, ZCC, ZDX, ZWA) and both OneAPI and Legacy clients.

gov-cloud-routing.statement: With cloud set to `gov` or `govus` the Python SDK sends OAuth to a zidentitygov.net or zidentitygov.us identity provider and API calls to api.zscalergov.net or api.zscalergov.us, instead of the commercial gateway.

quotes: "gov": "zidentitygov.net"
"govus": "zidentitygov.us"
"gov": "https://api.zscalergov.net"
"govus": "https://api.zscalergov.us"
identity provider and API gateway than the commercial clouds.
OneAPI supports the Zscaler government (FedRAMP) clouds.

gov-since-1-9-32.statement: The changelog records OneAPI support for the government clouds in release 1.9.32 (PR #534), and the same entry also appears under 1.9.31 (Issue #526); it notes that before the change these clouds produced non-resolvable hostnames and failed on every call.

quotes: Added OneAPI (Zidentity) support for the government (FedRAMP) clouds.
Previously these clouds produced non-resolvable hostnames and failed on every call.
[PR #534](https://github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-python/issues/534) - Added OneAPI (Zidentity) support for the government (FedRAMP) clouds.
[Issue #526](https://github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-python/issues/526) - Added OneAPI (Zidentity) support for the government (FedRAMP) clouds.

older-sdk-gov-unsupported.statement: Early 1.0.x release notes of the Python SDK warn that OneAPI and Zidentity are not supported for the zscalergov and zscalerten ZIA clouds or the ZPA GOV and GOVUS clouds, and point government customers to the legacy framework.

quotes: OneAPI and Zidentity is not currently supported for the following ZIA clouds: `zscalergov` and `zscalerten`
or ZPA `GOV`, and `GOVUS`. Please refer to the Zscaler Legacy API Framework section in the [README]

legacy-framework.statement: A tenant that has not migrated to Zidentity must use the SDK's legacy API client, which uses the product's own credentials; for ZIA the legacy credentials are username, password and an API key.

quotes: you must use the respective Legacy API client described in the following section
Legacy per-product authentication (ZIA `username`/`password`/`api_key`
If your Zscaler tenant has not been migrated to the new Zscaler

quotes: **v2.x is OneAPI-only.**
